evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our price Instructure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? -- asked only after the full inventory (electric bikes, tools, storage bins, plants) had already been collected.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'Yup. No.' to the agenda question -- no real concern raised, full credit applies.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: once we go over the minimum, the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments

top_strength: Recognized a repeat customer's second-phase move cleanly, pulled the prior job for reference, and handled an unusual item list (concrete loveseat, metal sculpture, plants needing a liability waiver) with confidence.
coaching_note: Call ended abruptly when the customer had to jump to a meeting before any close attempt -- nothing was booked and no rate-lock or explicit ask happened; worth a quick follow-up to actually close the loop.
